{npc:Hector The Mentor}, a Thais philosopher and mentor at the Edron academy, lost his students in a cave east of Thais, attacked by rabid wolves. Go down into the Rabid Wolf Cave, fight through {creature:Rabid Wolf|Rabid Wolves} and {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}, defeat the mini-boss {creature:Trollwut} and collect the {item:Maddening Mushroom} that drives the animals mad. At the end you choose a reward for your vocation and take the mushroom to {npc:Benjamin}, in the Thais depot.

Some of Hector's students were doing geological experiments, exploring the depths of this world. Rabid wolves tore apart the students who had gone deepest into the cave, while the others fled to the entrance. In the end, only Hector survived: he was the slowest of all and had not gone far into the hole.

{npc:Hector The Mentor} is also a small shop ({key:trade}): he sells {item:Small Health Potion} (20 gp), {item:Health Potion} (50 gp), {item:Mana Potion} (56 gp), {item:Antidote Potion} (50 gp), {item:Rope} (50 gp) and {item:Shovel} (50 gp). Buy what you need before going down.
Say {key:services} to Hector: he offers bank services, teaches spells and heals you.
Hector buys {item:Wolf Paw} (70 gp), {item:Wolf Tooth Chain} (100 gp) and {item:Bunch of Troll Hair} (30 gp), which the wolves and the Trollwut drop.
Do not kill the {creature:Trollwut} while you are standing on the quest door: that kill does not count and you would have to kill it again.

If you are not in **Thais** yet, travel there: at any port with a connection to Thais, talk to the captain and say {key:hi}, {key:thais} and {key:yes}. In Thais, the boat arrives at {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s port, in the west part of the city.

Leave Thais to the **east**. {npc:Hector The Mentor} is outside the city, to the **east-southeast**, on the Thais peninsula, on the surface ({coord:32476,32286,7}). You go on foot; to return to the city, walk the same way to the **west-northwest**.
Talk to {npc:Hector The Mentor}: say {key:hi} and then {key:mission}, the word he highlights in the greeting. Accept the mission he offers: to help find out what is going on in the cave nearby.
There is no known transcript of the mission conversation: if he asks you a question, follow the words he highlights in the dialogue.
Killing the 20 wolves and returning to Hector is an **optional** step. If you want to skip it, do only the first step of this section (get to the cave) and go straight to section 4.
Get to the Rabid Wolf Cave

The cave (Rabid Wolf Cave, also called {wiki:Thais Wolf Den|Thais Wolf Den}) is a few steps from Hector. From him, go **east** and then a bit **north**, to the entrance on the mountainside ({coord:32505,32283,7}). Go down there to enter the cave.
Surface map: the path (blue line) east to the cave entrance (yellow dot)

Inside the cave, kill 20 {creature:Rabid Wolf|Rabid Wolves}. There are wolves along the path described in section 4: one in stretch 1 and many in stretches 3 and 4 (use the maps in that section to find your way).
Rabid Wolves hit up to 30 per blow. At level 8–10, do not pull too many at once and drink potions early.

Leave the cave the same way you came in (go up to the entrance, {coord:32505,32283,7}) and return to {npc:Hector The Mentor}, a bit to the **west**. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to report the mission. After that, the goal becomes finding the cause of the wolves' rage, deep in the cave.

Enter the Rabid Wolf Cave again ({coord:32505,32283,7}). The Trollwut is at the bottom, 2 floors below the surface. The path has four stretches: on each map, follow the blue line from one yellow dot (stairs/passage) to the next.
Follow the blue arrow from **west** to **east** to the yellow dot on the other side. Here you find a {creature:Rabid Wolf}.
Stretch 1: follow the arrow from west to east
Follow the blue line from **southwest** to **northeast**, to the next yellow dot. Here you find two {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}.

Follow the blue line from **south** to **north**. This stretch has many {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats} and many {creature:Rabid Wolf|Rabid Wolves}. Halfway along, on the **west** side, open the chest marked with a red **X** on the map to get 2 {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions}.
Stretch 3: from south to north; the red X marks the chest with the potions

Follow the blue line from the yellow dot to the **southeast**, to the **northwest**, then **north** and finally **west**, to the quest door at the end of the line. There are many {creature:Rabid Wolf|Rabid Wolves}. If the gate around the **X** on the map (east of the path) is open, you may also meet up to two {creature:Ragged Rabid Wolf|Ragged Rabid Wolves}.
Stretch 4: the last stretch to the quest door; the X marks the gate area
The {creature:Ragged Rabid Wolf|Ragged Rabid Wolves} are stronger (120 HP, up to 50 per blow). Heal before you advance.
At the end of the last stretch, go through the quest door. On the other side the mini-boss {creature:Trollwut} awaits you. Move away from the door before you start the real fight.
Fight the {creature:Trollwut} with everything you have. It has 280 HP and hits up to 55 per blow (melee only). It always drops a {item:Platinum Coin} and a {item:Bunch of Troll Hair}.
The fight with the Trollwut, surrounded by fire fields
If you kill it while you are **inside the quest door**, the kill does not count and you have to kill it again.
The Trollwut walks around fire, energy and poison fields (it does not walk over them). If you have field runes, you can use them to slow it down, as shown in the image.

After you kill the Trollwut, go **north** and enter through the quest door. In the room, use the corpse (red circle in the image) to get a {item:Maddening Mushroom}, an infested mushroom used to enrage wild animals.
The reward room: the corpse (red circle) and the vocation doors (colored X marks)

In the same room there are colored quest doors, one per vocation. Enter your vocation's door to get the reward. The positions below are those in the previous image, which only marks the doors of Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer and Druid; no source gives the color or position of the Monk's door.
10 × {item:Fire Field Rune}, 10 × {item:Energy Field Rune} and 10 × {item:Poison Field Rune}
10 × {item:Intense Healing Rune}, 10 × {item:Cure Poison Rune} and 10 × {item:Destroy Field Rune}

There is no known exit shortcut: go back the same way. Leave the reward room through the gate to the **south**, pass the Trollwut area and the quest door, and redo the four stretches in reverse (from 4 to 1), always via the yellow dots, until you are back on the surface (the Trollwut is 2 floors below it) and leave through the cave entrance, near Hector.
Bring a {item:Rope}: if any passage is a hole, you use it to climb back up.

Go back to {npc:Hector The Mentor}, a bit to the **west** of the cave entrance, and talk to him about the mission ({key:hi}, {key:mission}). He asks you to take the {item:Maddening Mushroom} to {npc:Benjamin}, in the Thais depot, so the mushroom can be sent to the Edron academy and investigated.

Walk back to **Thais** (to the **west-northwest**) and go to the depot, at the corner of Harbour Street and Main Street, where the post office is. Talk to {npc:Benjamin} ({key:hi}) with the {item:Maddening Mushroom} in your inventory and hand it over to finish the quest.
The exact words for this hand-over are not recorded: if he does not react to {key:hi}, follow the words he highlights in the dialogue.
The quest shows up in the Quest Log under *Tibia Tales*.
It is also known as the **Rabid Wolf Quest** or **Trollwut Quest** (sometimes written *Ravnous Madness Quest*).
The cave is a hunting area for low levels, introduced in early 2024 with the tutorial for new players on the Thais peninsula.
